summary: End-to-end testing of Catalogue Match (mock) workflow. Backend pytest 7/7 PASS, full UI E2E flow PASS. Verified deterministic 5-result generation, persistence under project.match_results.<zone>, file-upload metadata-only, cross-user 404 isolation, 400 on unknown zone, 401 unauthenticated. Frontend: 9-column Analysis table with Find Matches button, navigation with ?zone=, Match page elements, 5 cards w/ correct fields (3 reasons, disqualifier on cards 3-4 only), score labels, percent badges 50-98, button text toggles to 'Re-run match' and 'View matches', revisit loads saved cards immediately, invalid zone shows empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 999 lines — close to the 700-line guideline ceiling. Consider extracting MOCK_PRODUCT_LIBRARY, MATCH_REASONS_LIBRARY, DISQUALIFIER_LIBRARY and the deterministic match logic into a separate /app/backend/match_engine.py module for maintainability.
Match.jsx (~383 lines) is fine but the inline scoreBadgeStyle / attachPreview helpers could be lifted into /app/frontend/src/lib/match-utils.js for reuse with future real-match implementation.
Analysis.jsx and Match.jsx both reference project.match_results.<zone> — small risk of stale state if a user runs match in two tabs. Not blocking for MVP.
test_credentials: Used fresh-registered test users (TEST_match_<uuid>@test.com / MatchTest2026!). Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md were NOT touched.
seed_data_creation: Per-test fresh users + projects; module-scoped fixture deletes its project at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_match.py (7) and test_mock_analyze.py (6). Both can be run together: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Match endpoint is fast (<200ms, no LLM). To exercise the full UI chain: register -> create project + upload ref jpeg -> click Analyse Materials -> click find-matches-btn-0 -> Run Match. The Match page testids are: match-page, match-no-zone, match-empty, match-reference-card, match-selected-material, match-prompt-input, match-upload-pdf, match-upload-images, run-match-btn, match-loading, match-results, match-card-{i}, match-thumb-{i}, match-label-{i}, match-percent-{i}, match-reasons-{i}, match-disqualifier-{i}. Determinism contract: same project_id + zone => identical product_name list and identical match_percent list across runs.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All acceptance criteria from the review_request met.
